closure_invariants.C3_baryon: Yn + Yp + Yh == 1 (constructed from baryon conservation)

mapping.Abar: NaN (CLD continuous-phase model does not fix cluster nucleon count)
mapping.Yh: f * rho_I / rho_B  (heavy-group baryon fraction = cluster)
mapping.Yn: (1-f) * rho_II / rho_B  (free neutron, gas is pure neutron)
mapping.Zbar: NaN (ditto; Zbar/Abar = rho_Ip/rho_I is the exact charge ratio)

non_claims: Abar/Zbar absolute values are not produced; the CLD continuous-phase model treats the cluster as a liquid-drop phase without a fixed nucleon count. The C3/C4 closures use only the ratio Zbar/Abar = rho_Ip/rho_I, which is exact.
This is a composition table, not a complete CompOSE eos.thermo/eos.compo pair; the thermodynamic table comes from the native DD-RMF + CLD reconstruction.
No core-crust matching, TOV, tidal or Cowling output is generated.
